app.name: AuraHealth
app.tagline: A clearer path to human help.
app.prototype: Prototype for simulated use only. Not approved or registered as a medical device.
app.setup: Android app. The handoff card, guide finder and report reader need the optional laptop server.
emergency.title: Call emergency services
emergency.body: {number} is India's emergency number for police, fire and medical help.
emergency.needsNetwork: A call needs mobile network coverage. AuraHealth cannot place calls without it.
emergency.dialerNote: Tapping opens your phone's dialer. Nothing is called automatically.
emergency.showCard: When they answer, you can read out or show your handoff card.
home.intro: AuraHealth helps a family in the first hour at home: first aid step by step, a night guard that calls for help, medicine reminders that tell a guardian, and a clear card to read to the emergency operator.
home.how1: Answer a few short questions. "I don't know" is always fine.
home.how2: Optionally add a report. A local model reads it and you check every field.
home.how3: Get a handoff card that shows where every detail came from.
status.title: Status
status.offlineNote: SOS, first-aid guides, readings, reminders and the night guard run on this phone. Muse Glimmer needs internet. The handoff card, guide finder and report reader need the laptop server.

what.assistLanguage: The text helper works in English in this prototype. Your description is kept as you wrote it.

card.report: From a report (confirmed by the user)

evidence.title: Where this came from

share.note: Nothing is sent anywhere. You choose what to show or share.
cannot.title: AuraHealth has not examined anyone
cannot.body: It doesn't give a diagnosis or treatment. If you are worried, contact {number} or a healthcare professional.
privacy.title: Your data
privacy.body: Family details and reminders are saved on this phone. Handoff answers are saved on the laptop server in a file that is not encrypted. There are no accounts and no analytics. Questions to Aura, guide-finder words and report photos go to NVIDIA over the internet, and NVIDIA's trial terms let it use them to improve its products. Texts and calls go to the people you choose.
privacy.lan: Anyone on the same Wi-Fi who has the pairing link could open this app. Use a trusted network.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Delete all answers and report images from this laptop?
about.title: About this prototype
about.body: AuraHealth is a hackathon research prototype that helps a family understand health questions and act in the first hour at home. It is not a doctor, no clinician has reviewed it, and it is not clinically validated. Do not use it with real patients.
server.down: The laptop server isn't reachable. SOS and the first-aid guides still work.
home.replaceConfirm: Start again? This deletes the saved handoff on this laptop.
what.flag: This reads like an instruction. AuraHealth doesn't follow it; it is kept only as your words.
what.edited: You changed the description, so the split points were cleared. Split again if you like.
what.noPoints: The text helper didn't return any of your exact words, so your description is kept as you wrote it.
doc.noFieldsYet: No fields yet. Add the ones you can read on the image.
doc.uploadFailed: That file couldn't be used. Choose a photo or image file.
status.lanOn: Wi-Fi mode: paired phones on this network can connect
evidence.helperModel: Split by {model}. The words are yours.
about.voice: In the Android app you can speak a question using the phone's speech recognizer, which may need internet. Steps and replies can be read aloud by the phone. A real spoken question has not been tested yet.
what.uncovered: {count} part(s) of your words were not in any point, so they were added as you wrote them.
home.helpNote: Step-by-step first aid while you wait for help, adapted from Red Cross guidelines.
help.title: What is happening?
help.hint: If you can, call {number} first. Then pick what you see.
help.englishOnly: The first-aid steps are in English only in this prototype.
finder.open: Not sure which one? Describe what you see
finder.label: What do you see?
finder.placeholder: For example: my father fell and is not answering
finder.note: Llama 3.2 3B on the laptop points to one of these guides and shows the words it matched. It does not judge how serious it is. You choose. Your words are not saved.
finder.noteOnline: Meta's Muse Glimmer (online, hosted by NVIDIA) points to one of 7 common emergency guides and shows the words it matched. You choose. Your words go to NVIDIA for this; AuraHealth keeps no copy.
finder.none: The guide finder knows only 7 of the guides and none matched. Pick one from the full list below. If someone collapsed or is not responding, use “Someone collapsed: start here”.
finder.unavailable: The guide finder needs the laptop helper. Pick a guide below.
finder.unavailableOnline: Could not reach Muse Glimmer (it needs internet). Pick a guide below.
finder.language: The guide finder works in English only in this prototype. Pick a guide below.
guide.finished: All steps done. Stay with them and keep watching their breathing until help arrives.
guide.pending: {count} step(s) are saved on this phone only. They will reach the handoff card if the laptop server becomes reachable.
evidence.guideSource: From the guide "{guide}", adapted from the IFRC 2020 first aid guidelines.
home.cardNote: Answers and times for the doctor
guard.title: Night guard
guard.lead: For someone who sleeps alone. If they can't speak, they can still ask for help.
guard.how1: Knock 3 times on the bed or table if you need help.
guard.how2: The phone asks loudly "Are you OK?" for 30 seconds.
guard.how3: If nobody taps "I'm OK", it phones the neighbour and texts the family.
guard.listening: Listening. Keep the phone near the bed and charging.
guard.morning: Morning check: alert if there is no "Good morning" by
guard.morningTry: Try the morning check in 1 minute (no call)
guard.morningTryStarted: The morning check will run in about a minute, as a test. Nobody will be called.
guard.morningNote: For a stroke or a fall in the night, when knocking may not be possible. Works while the night guard is on.
guard.webOnly: The night guard needs the AuraHealth Android app: a web page cannot listen while the phone sleeps or make calls. Check-ins below work here too.
guard.contactsNote: Phone numbers stay on this phone. They are never sent to the laptop.
guard.name: Name
guard.no112: Phones do not let any app call {number} by itself. The alert goes to people near you, and the big button calls {number}.
guard.checkinsNote: These times go on the handoff card, so whoever helps can see when the person was last seen well.
guard.perm.fullscreen: Full-screen alert over the lock screen
guard.perm.battery: Battery saving may stop the night guard at night
alert.title: Are you OK?
alert.body: If nobody taps below, AuraHealth will phone {neighbour} and text {family} in {seconds} seconds.
alert.test: This is a test. Nobody will be called.
alert.calling: A call to {neighbour} was started and a text was handed to the phone for {family}.
alert.callingTest: Test finished. In a real alert, AuraHealth would now phone {neighbour} and text {family}.
hub.title: Laptop AI helper
hub.note: Type the address and code shown in the laptop window (for example http://192.168.1.10:8000 and the code after code=). Leave it empty to use the app on its own.
guard.perm.batteryFix: Turn off battery saving for AuraHealth
doc.readGlimmer: Read it with Meta Muse Glimmer (online)
doc.glimmerNote: Sends the photo to NVIDIA's servers, where Meta's open Muse Glimmer model reads it (free). Use only the synthetic samples in this prototype. You still check every field against the photo.
doc.readOcr: Read it on this laptop (free, offline)
doc.ocrNote: Windows' built-in text reader finds the printed words, then Llama 3.2 3B sorts them into fields, copying them exactly. Nothing leaves the laptop. The text reader can misread numbers (for example 148/92 as 48/9), so check every field against the photo.
doc.onlineNote: This sends the photo to Meta's servers over the internet (Muse Spark). Use only the synthetic samples in this prototype. You still check every field.
doc.readLocal: Read it on this laptop (Llama 3.2 Vision)
doc.noReader: No reader is available right now. Type the details yourself, or set the Meta key to read photos online.
status.ocr: Photo reader · Windows text reader + Llama 3.2 3B
status.ocrNo: Not available (needs Windows and the text helper)
status.cannotRun: Downloaded, but this Ollama cannot run it

health.title: Health card
health.note: Typed in by the family, not checked by AuraHealth. Read it to the emergency operator or show it to the ambulance crew.
health.emptyNote: Save the name, age, health conditions, allergies and medicines of the people at home, so they are ready to tell the operator in an emergency.
family.title: Family & health
family.lead: The people at home and who to contact. Saved on this phone only.
family.name: Name
family.ph.conditions: As the doctor told you, for example: diabetes, high blood pressure
family.ph.medicines: Names as on the strip, for example: Metformin 500 mg, twice a day
family.ph.notes: For example: uses a hearing aid, has a pacemaker, lives alone
family.main: Main person: shown first on the health card and named in alert texts
family.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
family.contactsNote: Who AuraHealth phones or texts in an alert, and who is told when a dose is not marked taken.
family.roleLong.call: Phone them in a night-guard alert (only the first one marked is phoned: best someone nearby, like a neighbour)
family.roleLong.text: Text them in a night-guard alert, with the phone's location
family.roleLong.guardian: Guardian: text them if a medicine is not marked taken
family.roleCall: Marked to phone (only the first is phoned)
family.locationInAlerts: Add the phone's location (a map link) to night-guard alert texts. It is measured only when an alert goes out.
family.locationNotAllowed: AuraHealth may not use location yet. Allow it when Android asks, or in Settings → Apps → AuraHealth → Permissions.
family.locationOff: Location is switched off on this phone. Turn it on in quick settings.
family.country: Country: {country} · emergency number {number}. Other countries are not set up yet.
family.privacy: Names, numbers and health notes are kept on this phone. Health notes go to the laptop only if you use them in a handoff card. Numbers are only used for the calls and texts you set up.
meds.title: Medicines
meds.lead: Reminders at the times the doctor prescribed. If a dose is not marked taken in time, the guardian gets a text.
meds.webOnly: Reminders need the AuraHealth Android app: a web page cannot wake the phone at medicine time.
meds.perm.notify: Notifications are not allowed, so reminders cannot show.
meds.perm.sms: Texts are not allowed, so guardians cannot be told.
meds.perm.exact: Exact alarms are not allowed, so reminders may be a few minutes late.
meds.status.due: due now, not marked taken yet
meds.toldGuardians: text handed to the phone for {n} guardian(s); delivery not confirmed
meds.noAdvice: Type the medicine and amount exactly as the doctor prescribed. AuraHealth never suggests medicines or amounts.
meds.name: Medicine (as written on the strip)
meds.ph.name: For example: Metformin 500 mg
meds.wait: If it is not marked taken, text the guardian after
meds.guardiansAre: Told when a dose is not marked taken: {names}
meds.noGuardian: No guardian is set, so nobody will be told when a dose is not marked taken.
meds.try: Try it: a test reminder in 1 minute
meds.tryStarted: Test reminder set for about 1 minute from now
meds.tryNote: If you don't tap Taken, your guardians get a text marked TEST about a minute later.
meds.tryNoteNobody: The reminder will show, but with no guardian set nobody gets a text.
nearby.title: Help nearby
nearby.note: Opens Google Maps (needs internet). Maps chooses what it shows, and may not show the closest first. Sharing sends a map link of where this phone is.
nearby.shareText: I need help. My location: {link} (within about {m} m). Sent from AuraHealth.
nearby.shared: Location found (within about {m} m). Pick who to send it to.
nearby.err.permission: AuraHealth may not use location. Allow it when Android asks, or in Settings.
nearby.err.off: Location is switched off on this phone. Turn it on and try again.
nearby.err.unknown: Could not find the location. Try again near a window or outside.
nearby.err.unsupported: This browser cannot share a location here. Use the AuraHealth app.
nearby.noApp: No app on this phone can open that link.
chat.title: Talk to Aura
chat.lead: Ask about a symptom, a test result or a medicine, or what to do in an emergency. Aura is not a doctor and has not examined anyone.
chat.hello: Hello, I'm Aura. Tell me what is happening, or ask me about the app.
chat.ex1: My father collapsed and is not answering
chat.sourceAi: Meta Muse Glimmer (online) · checked by the app's rules
chat.noteOnline: Questions about the app and your saved details are answered on this phone. Other questions go through the laptop to Meta's Muse Glimmer model, hosted by NVIDIA. AuraHealth keeps no copy, but NVIDIA's trial terms let it use what is sent to improve its products, so do not type names or other private details.
chat.noteOffline: The AI is not available, so Aura answers only simple questions on this phone. The first-aid guides and the call button always work.
chat.emergency: Call {number} now. Then open the guide below and follow it step by step.
chat.offline: I can't answer that without the AI. You can open the first-aid guides, or call {number} if it is an emergency.
chat.aiFailed: Sorry, I could not get an answer just now. You can open the first-aid guides, or call {number} if it is an emergency.
chat.voiceErr.no_match: I didn't catch that. Tap the microphone and try again.
chat.voiceErr.silence: I didn't hear anything. Tap the microphone and speak.
chat.voiceErr.network: Voice needs internet on this phone (or Google's offline English pack). You can type instead.
chat.voiceErr.permission: AuraHealth needs the microphone for voice. Allow it when Android asks.
chat.voiceErr.audio: The microphone is busy (the night guard may be listening). You can type instead.
chat.voiceErr.busy: Voice is busy. Try again in a moment.
chat.voiceErr.unavailable: This phone has no speech recognizer. You can type instead.
chat.voiceErr.other: Voice did not work. You can type instead.
chat.local.medsNone: No medicine reminders are set for today. You can add them in Medicines.
chat.local.call: Tap the button to call {number}. Put the phone on speaker so your hands are free.
chat.local.pharmacy: This opens Google Maps with medical stores near you. It needs internet.
chat.local.hospital: This opens Google Maps with hospitals near you. It needs internet. In an emergency, call {number} first.
chat.local.location: Tap the button: I'll find where this phone is, and you pick who to send the map link to.
chat.local.noPerson: Nobody is saved yet. Add the people at home in Family & health.
chat.local.blood: {name}'s blood group is {blood}, as saved by the family.
chat.local.allergies: {name}'s allergies, as saved by the family: {text}.
chat.local.allergiesUnknown: No allergies are saved for {name}. That does not mean there are none.
chat.local.guard: The night guard listens for 3 knocks. If nobody taps "I'm OK" within 30 seconds, it phones your first contact and texts the family.
chat.local.addPerson: To add someone, open Family & health and tap Add a person. Their name, age, health notes, allergies and medicines stay on this phone.
chat.noSource: No MedlinePlus topic in the app matched this, so treat it as general information.
chat.sourceNote: Written for the United States, so care in India can differ. No clinician has checked this for AuraHealth.
chat.sourceFacts: From MedlinePlus, saved on this phone. Not written by AI.
home.askNote: Most questions go to NVIDIA's AI service. Do not type names or private details.
chat.factsNote: If this is happening now and seems serious, call {number}. The AI could not answer yet, so this is general information.
alert.noContacts: Nobody is set up to be phoned or texted. If you need help, call {number}.
alert.calledOnly: A call to {neighbour} was started. The family could not be texted.
alert.textedOnly: Could not phone {neighbour}. A text was handed to the phone for {family}. Call {number} if you need help.
alert.nobody: Nobody could be phoned or texted. Call {number} now if you need help.
about.aiModel: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B, hosted by NVIDIA. It needs internet and an NVIDIA key saved on this phone or on the laptop server.
chat.local.about: I'm Aura. On this phone I can point you to the right first-aid guide and the call button, tell you today's medicines, read the family's saved health details, show the nearest hospital or medical store, and share your location. When the laptop is connected I can answer other questions too.
chat.local.card: The handoff card puts what happened in one place, to read to the operator.
guard.contactsWhere: Contacts are set in Family & health. Alert texts include the phone's location if you allow it there.
chat.notePhone: Questions about the app and your saved details are answered on this phone. Other questions go from this phone, over its own internet, to Meta's Muse Glimmer model, hosted by NVIDIA. AuraHealth keeps no copy, but NVIDIA's trial terms let it use what is sent to improve its products, so do not type names or other private details.
chat.keyRejected: NVIDIA did not accept the key saved on this phone. Save a new key below. In an emergency, call {number}.
chat.rateLimited: NVIDIA's free limit was reached. Try again in a minute. In an emergency, call {number}.
chat.noInternet: I couldn't reach the AI: this phone may have no internet. You can open the first-aid guides, or call {number} if it is an emergency.

home.question: What is worrying you?
home.setupNote: Your name, then the people at home and who to call. It takes two minutes and stays on this phone.
profile.name: Your name
profile.aiNoKey: Needs the laptop or a key on this phone
profile.settingsSub: Laptop, AI helper, photo reader, internet
profile.aboutSub: Privacy, sources, what AuraHealth does not do
profile.privacy: There is no account and no login: your profile, family details and reminders are kept on this phone only.
